title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: multi-location discount and seasonal promotion basis by tier
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's extra discount for an employer with multiple business locations enrolling above a tier's employee-count threshold, and the discount applied during promotional periods.

| Tier | Extra multi-location discount | Enrolled-employee threshold above which it applies | Seasonal promotional discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | 0% | 0 | 5% |
| Small Business Partner | 0% | 0 | 5% |
| Mid-Market Partner | 5% | 250 | 5% |
| Enterprise Partner | 10% | 1000 | 5% |
| Municipal Partner | 5% | 500 | 0% |
| Nonprofit Partner | 0% | 0 | 10% |

Where a tier's multi-location discount is zero, or its threshold is zero, that tier's employer receives no extra discount for multiple locations regardless of enrolled-employee count.
